title: Finding
description: One defensive assessment result produced by a scanner in any language. Version 1.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier of the rule that produced the finding.

description.description: What was observed and why it matters.

location.description: Workspace-relative location, e.g. 'config/app.yaml:12'. Absolute host paths must not be published.

scanner.description: Name of the scanner that produced the finding.

detected_at.description: UTC detection instant, RFC 3339 with a trailing 'Z'.

evidence_excerpt.description: Short redacted excerpt. Secret material discovered by a secret-detection scanner MUST be masked before it reaches this field.
